en.text: Jehoshaphat his son reigned in his place, and strengthened himself against Israel.

zhSimplified.text: 亚撒的儿子约沙法接续他作王，奋勇自强，防备以色列人，

zhTraditional.text: 亞撒的兒子約沙法接續他作王，奮勇自強，防備以色列人，

en.text: He placed forces in all the fortified cities of Judah, and set garrisons in the land of Judah and in the cities of Ephraim, which Asa his father had taken.

zhSimplified.text: 安置军兵在犹大一切坚固城里，又安置防兵在犹大地和他父亚撒所得以法莲的城邑中。

zhTraditional.text: 安置軍兵在猶大一切堅固城裏，又安置防兵在猶大地和他父亞撒所得以法蓮的城邑中。

en.text: The LORD was with Jehoshaphat, because he walked in the first ways of his father David, and didn’t seek the Baals,

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华与约沙法同在；因为他行他祖大卫初行的道，不寻求巴力，

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華與約沙法同在；因為他行他祖大衛初行的道，不尋求巴力，

en.text: but sought the God of his father, and walked in his commandments, and not in the ways of Israel.

zhSimplified.text: 只寻求他父亲的 神，遵行他的诫命，不效法以色列人的行为。

zhTraditional.text: 只尋求他父親的上帝，遵行他的誡命，不效法以色列人的行為。

en.text: Therefore the LORD established the kingdom in his hand. All Judah brought tribute to Jehoshaphat, and he had riches and honor in abundance.

zhSimplified.text: 所以耶和华坚定他的国，犹大众人给他进贡；约沙法大有尊荣资财。

zhTraditional.text: 所以耶和華堅定他的國，猶大眾人給他進貢；約沙法大有尊榮資財。

en.text: His heart was lifted up in the ways of the LORD. Furthermore, he took away the high places and the Asherah poles out of Judah.

zhSimplified.text: 他高兴遵行耶和华的道，并且从犹大除掉一切邱坛和木偶。

zhTraditional.text: 他高興遵行耶和華的道，並且從猶大除掉一切邱壇和木偶。

en.text: Also in the third year of his reign he sent his princes, even Ben Hail, Obadiah, Zechariah, Nethanel, and Micaiah, to teach in the cities of Judah;

zhSimplified.text: 他作王第三年，就差遣臣子便·亥伊勒、俄巴底、撒迦利雅、拿坦业、米该亚往犹大各城去教训百姓。

zhTraditional.text: 他作王第三年，就差遣臣子便‧亥伊勒、俄巴底、撒迦利雅、拿坦業、米該亞往猶大各城去教訓百姓。

en.text: and with them Levites, even Shemaiah, Nethaniah, Zebadiah, Asahel, Shemiramoth, Jehonathan, Adonijah, Tobijah, and Tobadonijah, the Levites; and with them Elishama and Jehoram, the priests.

zhSimplified.text: 同着他们有利未人示玛雅、尼探雅、西巴第雅、亚撒黑、示米拉末、约拿单、亚多尼雅、多比雅、驼·巴多尼雅，又有祭司以利沙玛、约兰同着他们。

zhTraditional.text: 同着他們有利未人示瑪雅、尼探雅、西巴第雅、亞撒黑、示米拉末、約拿單、亞多尼雅、多比雅、駝‧巴多尼雅，又有祭司以利沙瑪、約蘭同着他們。

en.text: They taught in Judah, having the book of the LORD’s law with them. They went about throughout all the cities of Judah and taught among the people.

zhSimplified.text: 他们带着耶和华的律法书，走遍犹大各城教训百姓。

zhTraditional.text: 他們帶着耶和華的律法書，走遍猶大各城教訓百姓。

en.text: The fear of the LORD fell on all the kingdoms of the lands that were around Judah, so that they made no war against Jehoshaphat.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华使犹大四围的列国都甚恐惧，不敢与约沙法争战。

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華使猶大四圍的列國都甚恐懼，不敢與約沙法爭戰。

en.text: Some of the Philistines brought Jehoshaphat presents and silver for tribute. The Arabians also brought him flocks: seven thousand seven hundred rams and seven thousand seven hundred male goats.

zhSimplified.text: 有些非利士人与约沙法送礼物，纳贡银。阿 拉伯人也送他公绵羊七千七百只，公山羊七千七百只。

zhTraditional.text: 有些非利士人與約沙法送禮物，納貢銀。阿拉伯人也送他公綿羊七千七百隻，公山羊七千七百隻。

en.text: Jehoshaphat grew great exceedingly; and he built fortresses and store cities in Judah.

zhSimplified.text: 约沙法日渐强大，在犹大建造营寨和积货城。

zhTraditional.text: 約沙法日漸強大，在猶大建造營寨和積貨城。

en.text: He had many works in the cities of Judah; and men of war, mighty men of valor, in Jerusalem.

zhSimplified.text: 他在犹大城邑中有许多工程，又在耶路撒冷有战士，就是大能的勇士。

zhTraditional.text: 他在猶大城邑中有許多工程，又在耶路撒冷有戰士，就是大能的勇士。

en.text: This was the numbering of them according to their fathers’ houses: From Judah, the captains of thousands: Adnah the captain, and with him three hundred thousand mighty men of valor;

zhSimplified.text: 他们的数目，按着宗族，记在下面：犹大族的，千夫长押拿为首率领大能的勇士—三十万；

zhTraditional.text: 他們的數目，按着宗族，記在下面：猶大族的千夫長押拿為首率領大能的勇士－三十萬；

en.text: and next to him Jehohanan the captain, and with him two hundred eighty thousand;

zhSimplified.text: 其次是，千夫长约哈难率领大能的勇士—二十八万；

zhTraditional.text: 其次是，千夫長約哈難率領大能的勇士－二十八萬；

en.text: and next to him Amasiah the son of Zichri, who willingly offered himself to the LORD, and with him two hundred thousand mighty men of valor.

zhSimplified.text: 其次是，细基利的儿子亚玛斯雅（他为耶和华牺牲自己）率领大能的勇士—二十万。

zhTraditional.text: 其次是，細基利的兒子亞瑪斯雅（他為耶和華犧牲自己）率領大能的勇士－二十萬。

en.text: From Benjamin: Eliada, a mighty man of valor, and with him two hundred thousand armed with bow and shield;

zhSimplified.text: 便雅悯族，是大能的勇士以利雅大率领拿弓箭和盾牌的—二十万；

zhTraditional.text: 便雅憫族，是大能的勇士以利雅大率領拿弓箭和盾牌的－二十萬；

en.text: and next to him Jehozabad, and with him one hundred eighty thousand ready and prepared for war.

zhSimplified.text: 其次是，约萨拔率领预备打仗的—十八万。

zhTraditional.text: 其次是，約薩拔率領預備打仗的－十八萬。

en.text: These were those who waited on the king, in addition to those whom the king put in the fortified cities throughout all Judah.

zhSimplified.text: 这都是伺候王的，还有王在犹大全地坚固城所安置的不在其内。

zhTraditional.text: 這都是伺候王的，還有王在猶大全地堅固城所安置的不在其內。
